name: Chaotic procs at its own 8% chance, not 8%*8% (#4719)
contract: Chaotic 681376 reads a $h% chance (Spell.dbc ProcChance 8) on dealing damage to stack a damage buff. aura_ascension_felsworn_event::Check (case 681376, AscensionFelswornEvents.cpp) independently rolls roll_chance_f(info->ProcChance) via Chance(player, id) before the native proc system separately rolls CalcProcChance - the same double-gating mechanism as rev_20260928_95_felsworn_legionfall_proc_chance.sql's 801899, and the same parity migration zeroed 681376's spell_proc.Chance too, so the effective rate became 8%*8% = 0.64% instead of 8%. rev_20260928_96_felsworn_chaotic_proc_chance.sql restores Chance = 100. Each successful proc casts 572782 directly (no aura is named as its trigger), so spell_cast_count on 572782 counts exact proc events. 280 autoattack swings against a hostile dummy (entry 36) with near-guaranteed melee hit/no-dodge/no-parry give a binomial floor: at the true 8% rate P(successes >= 9) > 0.999; at the doubled-roll 0.64% rate P(successes >= 9) < 0.01% - min: 9 discriminates the two hypotheses with a false-failure probability under 0.03% and a false-pass probability under 0.01%.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle

~280 autoattack swings at a 2000ms weapon speed
DISCRIMINATING: a single roll at the DBC's 8% clears the binomial floor for 280 trials; a squared 0.64% roll does not
